"""Verify stress-scale results (certificates, feasibility, objectives)."""
import json
import random
import sys
import time

sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/vendor')
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tools')

from controller import run
from stress import wide_case
import verify


def main():
    mode = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'big'
    seed = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 11
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    if mode == 'big':
        cases = [wide_case(rng, 512, 256, 32, 32) for _ in range(2)]
    elif mode == 'many':
        cases = [wide_case(rng, 128, 256, 32, 32) for _ in range(8)]
    else:
        cases = [wide_case(rng, 256, 100, 16, 16) for _ in range(4)]
    out = run(json.dumps({'version': 3, 'cases': cases}).encode())
    if 'error' in out:
        print('ERROR', out)
        return 1
    bad = 0
    for index, (case, result) in enumerate(zip(cases, out['results'])):
        start = time.time()
        errors = verify.check(case, result)
        errors = verify.check_reports(case, result, errors)
        print('case %d: %.1fs %s' % (index, time.time() - start,
                                      'OK' if not errors else errors[:5]))
        if errors:
            bad += 1
    print('failures', bad)
    return 1 if bad else 0


if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())
PYEOF
